company.name: Datrics
company.shortDescription: Datrics is an AI-powered Analytics platform to help users explore data, generate insights and automate routines 10x faster.
company.description:
Datrics develops and offers an advanced AI platform and AI Analyst designed to enhance data processing and analytics for businesses. Our secure toolkit utilizes cutting-edge AI technology to learn unique terminologies, workflows, and metrics, delivering instant actionable insights tailored for specific business applications.

Our primary use cases include insurance claims processing, recruitment and hiring, financial planning and analysis, and a CFO Copilot focused on answering critical questions regarding unit economics and profits. 

Datrics also provides the Text2SQL framework, which simplifies converting plain language questions into precise SQL queries without coding.

We cater to organizations of all sizes, ensuring our solutions seamlessly integrate into existing infrastructures while automating the generation of insights and reports. Our mission is to transform how businesses harness the power of data, making advanced analytics accessible to every team and driving growth in today's data-driven landscape.
